note: A real, vendored (not live-cloned) snapshot for reproducibility and offline CI safety -- same rationale RefactorBench itself uses for its own real-repo problems. jsconfig.json enables allowJs but deliberately leaves checkJs off: confirmed live that checkJs against this real, complex, previously-untyped source produces dozens of pre-existing type errors unrelated to any mutation, swamping any real signal -- correctness here is checked structurally (fileContains/fileLacks/directoryLacks), not via compiler diagnostics.
